decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted  therewith (P/03, P/001, P-004, P/005 received 31 March 2010) and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - Before the facilities hereby approved are first brought into use, a litter collection bin shall be provided adjacent to each of them and shall be permanently retained thereafter.

Condition : 4 - Before the development hereby approved is commenced, details of sourcing of materials shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority to show the maximum possible use of reclaimed and recycled materials in the development.  The development shall be carried in accordance with the details so approved.

Condition : 5 - Before the development hereby approved is first brought into use, the developer shall submit to and have received approval from the local planning authority for a tree and shrub planting scheme and associated maintenance schedule, to be carried out in the areas shown for additional planting on drawing P-004.  The scheme so approved shall be carried out in the first available planting season after the approval of the details and thereafter maintained in accordance with the maintenance schedule.  Any plants or trees that die within the first five years of implementation shall be replaced with comparable specimens of similar size and maturity and maintained in accordance with the maintenance schedule.
description: Construction of a concrete wheel park for skateboards, bicycles, skates and other wheeled sport and a separate ball park for football and basketball with associated seating, tree and ornamental planting and landscape works.
